en.headline: Talent schemes draw 690,000 applications with 320,000 arrivals
en.dek: Chief Secretary Eric Chan said Hong Kong received about 690,000 applications under various talent admission schemes by September, with 320,000 people already arriving.
body: Hong Kong has received approximately 690,000 applications across its various talent admission schemes as of September, with around 320,000 individuals already arriving in the city, Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan Kwok-ki said on Sunday.

Chan spoke at the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area High-Quality Talent Development Conference in Dongguan. He noted that the nation's 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong's development into an international innovation and technology hub and a premier cluster for high-calibre global talent.

The city will better leverage its roles as a super-connector and super value-adder while cooperating with other Greater Bay Area cities to promote the region's talent appeal, he said. Hong Kong Talent Engage will step up outreach in key global regions to engage international professionals.

Chan added that the next conference will be held in Hong Kong, and authorities will prepare fully. Efforts include facilitating the flow of people, goods, capital and information, and aligning rules for convenient cross-boundary mobility.

zh.headline: 各項人才計劃接獲約69萬宗申請 32萬人已抵港
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，截至九月，特區政府各項人才計劃收到約69萬宗申請，約32萬人已抵港。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周日表示，截至九月，香港各項人才入境計劃共接獲約69萬宗申請，約32萬人已抵港。
陳國基在東莞出席粵港澳大灣區人才高質量發展大會時致辭。他指出，國家「十五五」規劃支持香港發展成為國際創新科技中心及匯聚全球高端人才的首選地。
他說，香港將更好發揮「超級聯繫人」及「超級增值人」角色，與大灣區其他城市合作，提升區域對人才的吸引力。香港人才服務辦公室將加強在全球重點地區的外展，主動接觸國際專業人士。
陳國基補充，下屆大會將在香港舉行，當局會全力籌備。有關工作包括便利人流、物流、資金流及信息流，並推動規則銜接，方便專業人士跨境流動。
